sota_benchmarks.note: S15 at 0.22034 is SOTA-competitive with published CNN (0.221). S14 LR at 0.22158 is 0.022 behind published LR 0.199. Gap likely due to feature engineering (ELO features critical per lit).

key_insights: Published LR achieves 0.199 Brier. Our S14 LR = 0.22158. Gap 0.022 — root cause: (1) ELO features (home_next, team_elo_5_y, team_elo) critical per literature, (2) different feature selection pipeline, (3) possible different train/test split.
Stacked ensemble L1(XGB+LGB+RF)->L2(LR): add as new model_type option to island mutation pool.
LSTM+MCDropout (MDPI 2026): sequential model for form streaks. Partial transfer: compute 5/10-game rolling Brier as calibration feature.
S15 xgboost_brier at 0.22034 is within 0.001 of CNN SOTA (0.221) — already competitive.
S13 extra_trees recovery 0.24535->0.23196 confirms model-type diversity is critical to escape local optima.
